title: Estimating the risk of cardiovascular disease using an obese-years metric
summary: In 5036 Framingham participants, cumulative obese-years showed a dose-response association with cardiovascular disease risk, stronger in men, and predicted risk slightly better than BMI level or obesity duration alone.

title: Excess Body Mass Index- and Waist Circumference-Years and Incident Cardiovascular Disease: The CARDIA Study
output: docs/papers/Obesity - 2015 - Reis - Excess body mass index‐ and waist circumference‐years and incident cardiovascular disease  The/Obesity - 2015 - Reis - Excess body mass index‐ and waist circumference‐years and incident cardiovascular disease  The.md
summary: In 4,061 CARDIA young adults followed ~25 years, cumulative excess BMI- and waist circumference-years predicted incident cardiovascular disease, coronary disease, and heart failure better than BMI or waist circumference alone.

title: Definition and diagnostic criteria of clinical obesity
summary: A Lancet Commission of 58 experts used Delphi consensus to define clinical obesity as excess adiposity causing organ dysfunction or daily-activity limitation, distinct from preclinical obesity, and recommended against BMI-only individual diagnosis.

title: The Lancet commission definition of clinical obesity: a multicohort cross-sectional analysis from early childhood to older age in seven high-income countries
summary: Across 786,557 people in 11 cohorts from seven high-income countries, Lancet Commission-defined clinical obesity was rarer than BMI-defined obesity in childhood but exceeded it from mid-to-late adulthood, peaking at 52% at 65–74 years.
